bio_sources.title: A Mathematical Theory of Communication

biography: Claude Shannon developed a mathematical theory of communication at Bell Labs. His 1948 paper treats information as statistical selection among possible messages and studies coding, noise and communication limits. Those engineering definitions do not by themselves measure meaning or human value.
name: Claude Shannon
